description: Performance gate for `rag bench` (docs/performance.md). Limits are the targets in docs/requirements.md section 7 and hold on any machine. Regression rules compare with a baseline from the same workload, configuration and machine. Time-based rules warn at 2x and fail at 4x, because two runs of the same commit on CI's shared runners differed by 90% (runs 42787520573 and the one after it); they catch an algorithmic blow-up, not drift. Memory, storage and tokens are deterministic, so their rules are tight. min_delta ignores changes too small to matter.

query.latency_ms.retrieval.p95.source: requirements 7: retrieval p95 under 300 ms at 10,000 chunks

stream.first_token_ms.p95.source: requirements 7: first token p95 under 3 s

pdf.seconds.source: requirements 7: a 100-page text PDF under 60 s

http.errors.source: every request in the load test succeeds
